notes: Corrects guarded exact-backup restore so a verified backup may remove locations or plate calibrations added by the transaction being undone; governed imports continue to reject coordinate deletion.

Binds the review and commit to the immutable source event, active machine identity, backup manifest SHA-256, evidence fingerprint, and exact backup-member hashes, and reopens that evidence before commit.
Makes restore removals explicit in the review window and keeps every changed restored target revoked pending separate exact-value verification.

Retains checkout-independent machine data, immutable configuration history, guarded location changes, verified pre-update backups, exact protected-byte checks, deployment anchors, and receipt-gated relaunch from rc.3.

The bundled firmware artifact is byte-identical to v1.3.0-rc.3, v1.3.0-rc.2, and v1.3.0-rc.1 (SHA-256 EDA070CE734D5167F0795FAF30DF461C8A07341E09CA698DE9D850315B0D5884). Direct v1.2.0-rc.6/v1.2.0 upgrades still require deployment; v1.3.0-rc.1/rc.2/rc.3 machines require verified matching provenance or redeployment.

requires_firmware.note: Use the v1.3 firmware artifact bundled with this release.
